Loss report: concourse -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/compile ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (config) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/test ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (config) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.cache: actions/cache step with a rolling key (the source has no key, so GitLab shares one cache named default across jobs; the key is <key>-run-<run_id> and the restore prefix is <key>-run-: each run saves a new cache and restores the newest by prefix, because actions/cache never overwrites a key; GitHub restores only caches of the current branch, the base branch of a pull request and the default branch, while a GitLab key with no branch part is shared across branches)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (Concourse fetches the repository with the get of the job; the depth param of the get maps to the step input, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/compile step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/test step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[native] pipeline/ci/job/build/synth/cache step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
[native] pipeline/ci/job/build/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
